#   scope): homeland, the height of its power, and hypothetical lands it never held.

# Alexander's Empire: homeland (province scope)
LR_title_zone_alexanders_empire_homeland_trigger = {
	OR = {
		geographical_region = custom_satrapy_macedonia
		geographical_region = custom_satrapy_greece
	}
}

# Alexander's Empire: height of power (province scope)
LR_title_zone_alexanders_empire_height_trigger = {
	geographical_region = world_alexanders_empire
}

# Alexander's Empire: hypothetical (province scope)
LR_title_zone_alexanders_empire_hypothetical_trigger = {
	geographical_region = custom_satrapy_magan
}

# Graeco-India: homeland (province scope)
LR_title_zone_graeco_india_homeland_trigger = {
	OR = {
		geographical_region = custom_satrapy_bactria
		geographical_region = custom_satrapy_poklais
	}
}

# Graeco-India: height of power (province scope)
LR_title_zone_graeco_india_height_trigger = {
	OR = {
		geographical_region = custom_strategia_pentapotamia
		geographical_region = custom_strategia_ariake
	}
}

# Graeco-India: hypothetical (province scope)
LR_title_zone_graeco_india_hypothetical_trigger = {
	OR = {
		geographical_region = custom_strategia_gangaradia
		geographical_region = custom_strategia_dakinabades
	}
}
